app_caption: V2 — quality control for Avaatech XRF Core Scanner acquisition.
sidebar_operator_help: Optional — identifies who ran this QC; recorded in the history.
audit_toggle_help: When enabled (default), each successful QC run is recorded in the local audit trail (data/audit.db) and appears in the History tab. When disabled, no run is recorded and the History tab is hidden — useful for hosted deployments without persistent local storage.
upload_info: Upload an .xlsx workbook exported by Avaatech.
no_sheets_error: No sheet with a recognizable energy (10kV/30kV/50kV) was found.
sheets_skipped_warning: Skipped sheet(s) — energy not recognized from the name: {sheets}.
no_valid_sheets_error: No sheet passed validation. Fix the errors above and re-upload the file.
audit_register_warning: Could not record this run in the audit trail: {error}
no_flagged_caption: No depth flagged for review in this energy.
audit_local_only: The audit history requires a local installation with a writable data/ directory. In hosted environments (e.g. Streamlit Community Cloud), data is not persisted between sessions.
validation_missing_columns: Required columns missing for energy {energy}: {columns}. Check that the workbook was exported correctly by Avaatech and that this sheet matches the detected energy.
validation_no_depth_column: No depth column found ('{depth_col}' or '{core_depth_col}'). Measurements cannot be ordered.
validation_depth_fallback: Column '{depth_col}' not found; using '{core_depth_col}' as the continuous depth. This is only correct for single-section cores — in multi-section cores, CoreDepth resets at each section and can distort depth ordering.
validation_no_rep0: No '{rep0_label}' measurement found in column '{replicate_col}'. QC requires at least the first pass (Rep0) to calculate metrics for this sheet.
feedback_body: Please include: processed file, energy, and a description of the problem.
